title: Member Interval and Early-Alignment Price Schedule — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Schedule of included-alignment intervals and member early prices for Alignment Services & Plans.** On a plan, a further included alignment becomes available once the interval measured from the last alignment that counts toward the interval has been reached; an alignment the holder wants before then is charged at the member early-alignment labor price of the line.

| Line | Interval, calendar months after the last interval alignment | Interval, miles after that alignment's odometer | How the two intervals combine | Member early-alignment labor price (USD) | An alignment at the member early price restarts the interval | Alignments per vehicle per visit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable | 89.99 | No | 1 |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable | 109.99 | No | 1 |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | 6 | 6000 | whichever comes first | 59.99 | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | 6 | 6000 | whichever comes first | 59.99 | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | 6 | 6000 | whichever comes first | 49.99 | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | 6 | 6000 | whichever comes first | 59.99 | Yes | 1 |

### Notes to the schedule

1. "Whichever comes first" means the interval is reached as soon as either the month figure or the mile figure is reached, whichever happens earlier.
2. A figure of 0 means the line has no interval: the two single-service lines include only their purchase-day alignment, so the member early-alignment price shown for them is the labor price of any later alignment on the holding.
3. On a line marked "Yes" in the restart column, an alignment charged at the member early price counts as the last interval alignment from which the next interval is measured; on a line marked "No" it does not.
4. One alignment is performed on one vehicle per visit on every line.

### Points of judgement

- *Hypothetical:* on a line with a 6-month, 6000-mile interval, a vehicle that has run 6000 miles since its last interval alignment has reached the interval even though fewer than 6 months have passed.
- *Hypothetical:* on the same line, a vehicle that has run 5999 miles and is short of the 6-month mark has not reached it, and an alignment then is charged at the line's member early-alignment price.
